name: 21084 · Jarrettsville, MD
findings: ZIP 21084 (Jarrettsville) has 23 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 10 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 21084 (Jarrettsville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 21084 (Jarrettsville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 59% of the typical level).
